summary: Iter-30 backend + frontend verification of Form Routing, Deeper Crawl (discover + import-selected) and Video Studio. Backend pytest: 23/23 pass in ~19s (test_iter30_routing_discover_videos.py, xdist-parallel). Frontend smoke on the live preview URL: Video Studio and WebImport dialog + Form Routing panel all render on the 'Crawl Final' tenant (TheCrawlSpace) with no runtime error overlay. Form routing: notify_email in a form-block's props is honoured (message.routing.notify_email = lowercased block value, response.routed_to = same); assignee in props is resolved to that member's email from db.users (assignee_id + notify_email + assignee_name persisted). Security cases all pass: (a) posting form_id + a notify_email in the PUBLIC payload — Pydantic drops the extra field, resolved routing stays only from the stored block (attacker email never lands anywhere on the message); (b) unknown form_id — lead is still created, routing.notify_email is None, response.routed_to is None (see minor note below); (c) form_id belonging to a DIFFERENT tenant — resolved page lookup is scoped by app_id so no cross-tenant leak (routed_to None, form_name != 'SECRET B FORM'). Default (no notify_email/assignee): routed_to None, no routing email. Videos backend: GET /apps/{id}/videos returns {videos, stock_enabled:false, providers:{pexels:false,pixabay:false}, ai_models:[veo3.1, kling-o3-pro], ai_enabled:true}. GET /videos/stock-search and POST /videos/auto-source both 400 with a message mentioning Pexels/Pixabay. POST /videos/import-one with a non-Pexels/Pixabay host → 400. POST /videos/ai-generate with model:'not-a-model' → 400 'Unknown video model'. GET /videos/job/{bogus} → 404. On Crawl Final: place with the existing AI mp4 URL is idempotent (2nd place adds no new video block for the same URL) and the mp4 streams over {REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}{video.url} with 200 and content-type video/mp4. Discover + import-selected on example.com: discover returns {discovery_id, brand, url, pages[slug,url,title,words,images,forms,videos,important], colors, totals, failures}; home '/' is marked important==true. max_pages=9999 is accepted (job doesn't crash — endpoint clamps to min(1, max(1, MAX_PAGES)) inside _run_discover). import-selected with slugs:['/'] + source_videos:true completes; pages exist via GET /apps/{id}/pages; no empty-url video blocks are ever persisted; result.videos is either absent OR reports saved==0 with a reason mentioning pexels/pixabay/api. Negative + permission paths: invalid URL → 400, localhost → 400 (sync from _norm_url), unknown discovery_id → 404 'Discovery expired', slugs:[] → 400 'Pick at least one page', viewer-role member → 403 on discover; 403/404 on import-selected. Did NOT trigger any AI video generation (would cost real ECU) — only contract-negative assertions per instructions. Frontend: Videos tab renders <VideoStudio> with video-studio, video-query-input, video-search-btn (disabled), video-auto-btn (disabled), video-prompt-input, video-model-select (2 options — Google Veo 3.1 + Kling O3 Pro), video-aspect-16-9, video-aspect-9-16, video-generate-btn, video-upload-btn and the library grid (video-item-* + video-place-btn-* rendered for the existing AI mp4). WebImport dialog exposes web-import-discover-btn, web-import-maxpages-input (default 100), web-import-scan-btn. Selecting a Form block in Site Mode on /contact-us surfaces form-routing-panel + form-assignee-select + form-notify-email-input. No Uncaught runtime errors overlay in either flow.

minor.issue: When form_id references a NON-EXISTENT block, the backend still writes routing={form_id: <supplied>, form_name: 'Form', form_page: null, notify_email: null, assignee_id: null} to the message. Real routing (notify_email) is correctly None so no email leaks, but the placeholder metadata pollutes the inbox. Consider skipping the whole routing object when the block cannot be resolved (page is None).

issues: A theme font selector (Default font <select>) floats over the Videos tab label on 1400x900. Minor z-index/positioning nit — the tab underline is still hittable but the label is partly covered by the dropdown.

action_items: Optional: in inbox.public_contact, don't attach a routing dict when the form block cannot be located (page is None). Currently it writes form_name='Form' + the client-supplied form_id even for unknown/foreign form_ids.
Optional cosmetic: fix z-index/position of the theme 'Default font' selector so it doesn't overlap the Videos tab label in the AppDetail header.
critical_code_review_comments: inbox.public_contact: routing block-name defaults to 'Form' when props.heading is empty — harmless but a bit noisy in the inbox UI; consider omitting form_name in that case.

videos.import_one SSRF check calls urlparse(...).hostname.endswith((...)) unconditionally; if the URL has no host (e.g. 'foo.mp4') hostname is None and .endswith would AttributeError. Not triggered by pydantic-validated inputs but worth guarding — `(host or '').endswith(...)`.

web_import.import_selected always calls _start with MAX_PAGES as the crawl budget regardless of the discovery's crawl length. Harmless because a pre-computed `crawl` is passed in, but the max_pages arg is dead in that code path — makes the API surface confusing.

web_import._run_discover clamps to `max(1, min(MAX_PAGES, body.max_pages))` — good; but there is no upper-bound validation on Pydantic DiscoverIn.max_pages, so a caller can send 10^9 and force a pointless clamp path. Enforce via Pydantic Field(le=MAX_PAGES) for a cleaner 422.

videos.list_videos filter uses regex ^video/ but does not $-anchor — fine for content-type matching. Also depends on files.content_type existing on all imported videos; older files may lack this and be hidden. Non-blocking.

inbox.ContactIn: relies on Pydantic ignoring unknown fields (default in v2) for the routing-security case. Consider `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='ignore')` explicitly for clarity, or `extra='forbid'` if you want to actively reject notify_email in the payload with a 422.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke — Video Studio + WebImport + Form Routing panel testids all present, no uncaught errors

seed_data_creation: Throwaway TEST_iter30_* tenants (auto-deleted in fixture teardown). One viewer user TEST_iter30_v_<hex>@example.com created via /auth/register (leaves a shell user — same pattern as iter-27/28/29). One test lead posted to each throwaway inbox with marker email addresses (alice@/bob@/g@example.com etc). Crawl Final (app_7035dfbf4a95) is preserved; the place-idempotence test may have added ONE additional 'video' block on '/' if it wasn't already there (subsequent calls are no-ops). No new files added to Crawl Final's library.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Single new test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter30_routing_discover_videos.py (23 tests, ~19s parallel). Uses example.com for discover flow (fast — 1 page). Video place-idempotence test depends on Crawl Final (app_7035dfbf4a95) still owning at least one video with an /api/public/files/... URL — if that tenant is wiped, remove or skip TestVideosBackend::test_place_and_idempotence_on_crawl_final and test_video_stream_public. Pydantic-extra behaviour is relied on for the routing security case (notify_email is silently ignored). If the ContactIn model is changed to extra='forbid', test_public_payload_notify_email_not_honoured will start returning 422 — update the assertion accordingly. Front-end smoke used /apps/:appId, not /app/:appId — earlier iter-29 used the same path.
rca of the issue: No blocking bug. Minor findings: (a) routing metadata is attached even for unknown form_ids (form_name='Form') — no security impact but noisy; suggest bailing out early when the block cannot be resolved. (b) Design: the 'Default font' selector overlaps the Videos tab label in the AppDetail header. (c) videos.import_one SSRF guard would AttributeError on a hostless URL — not reachable with typical inputs but worth guarding.
